name: settlement
description: Communities, strongholds, camps, and population centers

fields.name: Crossroads Village
fields.description: inns, stables, traders, and craftspeople serving traffic from three roads.

fields.name: Fishing Village
fields.description: boats, smokehouses, net sheds, and homes raised against seasonal floods.

fields.name: Mining Town
fields.description: Rough housing and busy foundries cluster around a wealthy company office and dangerous mine shafts.

fields.name: Pilgrim Town
fields.description: hostels, relic sellers, healers, and rival temples surrounding a sacred destination.

fields.name: Frontier Fort
fields.description: soldiers, settlers, workshops, and refugees sheltered behind unfinished defenses.

fields.name: Adventurer Camp
fields.description: tents, supply stalls, healers, mercenaries, and rumor boards beside unexplored ruins.

fields.name: Hill Castle
fields.description: a noble household and garrison overlooking farms gathered beneath its protection.

fields.name: River Port
fields.description: warehouses, ferries, shipyards, customs officers, and floating neighborhoods.

fields.name: Monastery Community
fields.description: monks, tenant farmers, guests, libraries, and workshops behind peaceful walls.

fields.name: Forest Enclave
fields.description: homes integrated into living trees and protected by scouts who control every path.

fields.name: Mountain Hold
fields.description: a fortified underground settlement built around mines, cisterns, and ancestral halls.

fields.name: Island Commune
fields.description: a self-sufficient harbor settlement governed through public meetings and shared labor.

fields.name: Free City
fields.description: an independent trade metropolis balancing guilds, foreign powers, and citizen factions.

fields.name: Underground Refuge
fields.description: descendants of disaster survivors living around finite water, light, and old machinery.

fields.name: Ruined City Camp
fields.description: scavengers and scholars occupying defensible blocks of a much larger dead metropolis.

fields.name: Farming Village
fields.description: A small community centered on barns, a mill, a weekly market, and common land.

fields.name: Market Town
fields.description: A regional center shaped by guilds, warehouses, taxes, and commercial rivalries.

fields.name: Fortified Port
fields.description: Quays protected by towers, a demanding harbor office, and districts of far-traveled sailors.

fields.name: Nomad Encampment
fields.description: Mobile homes organized around herds, craftspeople, and a clan council.

fields.name: Military Camp
fields.description: A temporary settlement of soldiers, engineers, healers, and civilian suppliers.

fields.name: Capital
fields.description: A metropolis where palaces, offices, barracks, markets, and poor districts compete for space.

fields.name: Underground City
fields.description: A lightless community built around shafts, caves, and ancient machines.

fields.name: Floating City
fields.description: Ships and platforms permanently linked around an anchorage, reef, or gigantic creature.

fields.name: Slum
fields.description: A dense district built from salvaged materials and governed by mutual-aid networks and informal authorities.

fields.name: Tribal Enclave
fields.description: A close community centered on tradition, sacred territory, and customary authority.
